Short summary / action items:
1) SCCs: We adopted the standard SCC clauses in Exhibit A and added a limited fallback to handle export routing. Two deviations are flagged in the consolidated doc (comments 7 and 12). Those are trade-offs around cross-border storage vs. routing and require exec clearance if HealthCore requires hard commitments.
2) Controller/Processor: We kept the explicit carve (Section 2.1) that processing for model inference does not change controller status; this should resolve the hosting examples you flagged.
3) Subprocessors & Regions: Priyom confirmed planned backup regions (US-WEST, EU-CENTRAL, APAC-STAGE-1) — included in the evidence pack.
4) Evidence: Laura confirmed the encryption attestation is cleared for disclosure and is included in the PDF.

- If you want us to remove the two flagged SCC items instead of requesting exec clearance, indicate which one and we will circulate a secondary pass.
